news.title: Mumbai: BMC panel approves leasing Century Mill land to Peddar Realty
news.para: The civic improvements committee approved leasing BMC's Century Mill land for thirty years. Opposition arose from Shiv Sena (UBT) and Congress regarding the land deal. A proposal to replace a sports complex reservation with a petrol pump was also cleared. Nearly nine thousand square meters of BMC land in Lower Parel will be integrated into an SRA scheme.

news.title: Rainwater harvesting must to get new water, drainage lines in old buildings in Maharashtra
news.para: The Maharashtra government has mandated that all new water connections adhere to rainwater harvesting and waste management protocols. Additionally, property owners are required to secure structural stability certificates for their older buildings. Municipal engineers will conduct inspections to ensure ample space for these systems. Upon successful installation and certification, local authorities will grant approval for new water connections.

news.title: Patna civic body approves four proposals; leasehold properties in six areas may go freehold
news.para: The Patna Municipal Corporation council has made significant strides by approving the conversion of leasehold properties to freehold. Additionally, plans for high-mast lights installation at thirty-five city locations will enhance safety. To boost water supply, five high-yield tube wells are set for construction. The council also scrutinized sanitation arrangements, penalizing outsourcing agencies, and deliberated on ward-specific civic matters for prompt action.

news.title: Punjab begins mapping legitimate raw material supply for stone crushers
news.para: The Punjab Pollution Control Board is currently evaluating legitimate sources of raw materials for stone crushers. This scrutiny is designed to guarantee adherence to state regulations and policies. In the Ropar district, a significant number of stone crushers obtain materials from Punjab, Haryana, and Himachal Pradesh. Alarmingly, over 42% of these units have been found to violate pollution control laws.

news.title: After Mumbai, Pune set for plot-wise ready reckoner rates under micro-zoning
news.para: Pune and Mumbai are set to implement a detailed property valuation system that will transition from broad zoning classifications to more specific rates tied to individual plots and buildings. The state registration department is gearing up to adjust property rates for the upcoming year while introducing reforms like new stamp duty offices and mandatory land measurement. Additionally, linking Aadhaar may be required for all document registrations.

news.title: Gujarat government mulls higher FSI, taller buildings in GIDCs
news.para: The Gujarat government is set to enhance the floor space index for industrial plots located within GIDC estates. Building height regulations will be adjusted based on road width, permitting taller constructions. This initiative is designed to support vertical growth in several manufacturing industries. Industry representatives have persistently called for these updates in response to evolving economic realities, and the proposed changes invite public feedback for consideration.

news.title: SRA targets over five lakh rehabilitation homes by 2030, plans 19 cluster redevelopments in Mumbai
news.para: The SRA has set an ambitious goal to construct over 500,000 homes by the end of 2030. To facilitate this, annual targets will hasten slum redevelopment initiatives throughout the area. Innovations like amnesty programs and collaborative models are introduced for projects that have stalled. Additionally, a digital framework and computerized systems will enhance operational efficiency, while the Dharavi redevelopment is advancing through three distinct phases.

news.title: Maharashtra mulls new law to cap upfront payment at 80% for agreement to sell
news.para: Maharashtra is set to implement a law to safeguard flat buyers from unethical builders. Under this new regulation, builders will be allowed to collect only eighty percent of the total payment at the time of signing the agreement, with the remaining amount payable only upon the final registration of the property.

news.title: WeWork Global sells 2.5% stake in WeWork India Management for ₹244 crore
news.para: WeWork Global has sold a 2.5% stake in WeWork India for Rs 244 crore, offloading 35 lakh shares in the open market last Friday. With this move, WeWork Global's stake decreased to 12.3%, but it retains the title of the largest shareholder. During the first quarter, WeWork India announced a consolidated net loss of Rs 4.30 crore.

news.title: Max Estates’ net profit declines 30% to ₹8.35 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Max Estates' consolidated total income remained broadly flat at ₹80.07 crore during the quarter. It recorded pre-sales of ₹1,093 crore and collections of approximately ₹491 crore.

news.title: High-Density Corridor Zone planned along UER-II under Delhi master plan 2047 to increase housing
news.para: In a bid to transform outer Delhi, the Master Plan 2047 emphasizes high-density development along Urban Extension Road-II. This initiative is designed to optimize land use and connect various areas more efficiently. To qualify for development, plots must have a minimum area of 4,000 square meters, with a maximum permissible FAR of 400. Additionally, twenty percent of the housing spaces will be dedicated to affordable options.

news.title: Ajay Devgn, Veena Devgan lease Juhu bungalow for ₹10.61 crore
news.para: Actor Ajay Devgn and his mother Veena Devgan have leased out a bungalow in Juhu, Mumbai, for five years, according to documents accessed by Square Yards. The lease starts at a monthly rent of ₹16 lakh and has an estimated cumulative rental value of ₹10.61 crore.

news.title: Puravankara posts ₹25.23 crore net profit in Q1 FY27
news.para: Puravankara's consolidated total income increased 62.8 per cent to ₹877.15 crore during the quarter. Pre-sales rose 28 per cent year-on-year to ₹1,439 crore, while collections increased 40 per cent to ₹1,199 crore.

news.title: Kerala: 30,000 beneficiaries to get houses under PMAY-Urban 2.0
news.para: Kerala will implement the second phase of PMAY-U, benefiting thirty thousand eligible residents.  The state government will sign an MoU with the Centre to secure central assistance.  Beneficiaries must contribute twenty-five percent of the total project cost for their new homes.  The state and Centre will jointly provide four lakh rupees for each homeless beneficiary.  This initiative aims to provide housing solutions as the first phase concludes.

news.title: Enforcement directorate conducts raids in NCR in homebuyers 'fraud' case
news.para: On Thursday, the Enforcement Directorate launched searches throughout the Delhi-NCR region as part of a money laundering investigation targeting AVJ Developers and Rudra Buildwell Construction. These companies are accused of deceiving homebuyers via a fraudulent subvention scheme, with the inquiry originating from two distinct CBI FIRs related to collusion between builders and banks.

news.title: Registry done, freehold granted, but ownership still stuck in files at Chandigarh estate office
news.para: For over fifteen years, families in Chandigarh have been grappling with exasperating delays in property mutation despite having paid all government dues and registered their sale deeds. Although their properties transitioned from leasehold to freehold, the UT estate office still withholds the crucial mutation. This bureaucratic entanglement disrupts essential transactions, such as securing loans, sales, and confirming clear ownership records.

news.title: Gadchiroli’s new regional planning authority to unlock infra potential
news.para: Gadchiroli district has been declared a separate region by the state government. A new Gadchiroli Regional Planning Authority will now guide its development. This authority replaces an outdated plan that governed the district for decades. The new body will facilitate planned land use and infrastructure development. It aims to spread industrial growth benefits across the district.

news.title: Maharashtra: IGR department proposes mandatory Aadhaar verification for property registration
news.para: The IGR department has introduced a plan to mandate Aadhaar authentication for property registrations to bolster security against impersonation and fraud. While optional currently for sub-registrars, this change entails amendments to existing laws. The state government needs to approve this proposal to implement the significant enhancement for safeguarding property transactions.

news.title: Facing backlash, Chennai civic body suspends property tax hike
news.para: In response to strong opposition from residents regarding inflated property tax bills, the Greater Chennai Corporation has suspended its revised tax for under-assessed properties. Tax amounts will revert to prior levels, with excess payments by taxpayers credited as advances. This initiative is part of a reassessment drive funded by the World Bank.

news.title: Emaar PMLA case: Tribunal upholds attachment of Koneru Pradeep’s $250,000 London policy
news.para: The Appellate Tribunal confirmed the Enforcement Directorate's seizure of an insurance policy owned by industrialist Koneru Pradeep in relation to a money laundering investigation. Despite Pradeep's claims that there were already adequate asset attachments, the tribunal found merit in the ED's tracing of premium payments to offshore funds associated with the Emaar project, which allegedly involved illicit cash collections from villa buyers.
